meta.description: Ground-truth labels for the 300-review evaluation set. 1 label was created by a human annotator; 299 were generated by an AI model (Claude) with mentor approval. See annotation_method.

annotation_method.ai_model: Claude (Anthropic); labels written by the coding assistant from the review text only
annotation_method.approved_by: project mentor (as reported by the team)
annotation_method.per_record_marker: notes begin with 'AI-assisted label'; 'DEBATABLE' marks cases recommended for human review
annotation_method.caveat: AI-assisted labels are not manual annotations. Prompt-evaluation scores measure agreement with these labels.
